harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent, legacy-compatible IPv4/IPv6 host firewall on node1. SSH and TCP/8080 are allowed; unrelated inbound traffic is rejected. Persistence and recovery were verified through a node restart.
actions_performed: Installed iptables/ip6tables rules with default-drop policies and terminal REJECT rules.
Allowed established traffic, DHCP, SSH, and TCP/8080.
Added an executable ifupdown pre-up hook to restore both rulesets.
Restarted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed firewall rules, SSH, network configuration, OS release, and kernel recovered unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound traffic
evidence.summary: Full active IPv4/IPv6 rulesets show TCP/22 and TCP/8080 ACCEPT rules followed by REJECT, with executable persistence files present before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed legacy OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were observed before configuration and remained unchanged after restart.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 7341d4aa-5eef-41d5-9151-d0d83ce28448, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 9aaa4fbf-20ce-439a-acb4-52de4b2e6d83, restored rulesets, active SSH listener, and recovered address/default route.
